title: Support during a rough patch
body:
My YT algorithm showed me ADHD Love last month and it was scarily relatable for someone pursuing an AuDHD assessment, and having an autistic partner. I finally subscribed to dubbii and OMG! I did more around the house today than I have in MONTHS, maybe even YEARS! 
Thank you Rox and Rich. Thank you so much. ❤️
author: Jazz017

title: This got app got me out of bed today.
body:
I have recently noticed the struggle I have getting out of bed and starting my day, and this is how it’s been my whole life. 
I tend to ban social media for myself in the mornings because it delays my start to the day. I’m glad I opened Facebook this morning as I saw that there will be a price increase to Dubbii soon (but locking in the current price if it’s paid for now). 

So I thought… stuff it, I’ll buy a year and if it doesn’t work then I would have only paid the cheaper price…

I was ruminating and hating myself for an hour in just not getting out of bed today, staring at the ceiling telling myself to just get up and go. Then I got the Dubbii app and clicked on a video to get out of bed. 

I got ready for the day in less than 15 minutes… and now here I am ready for the day almost in tears from relief of how easy getting out of bed this morning was.

author: Just here for Chloé

title: Routine - wow!
body:
I joined for the body doubling, but didn’t expect how great this would be for finding a daily routine. I’ve never had a bedtime routine, but since starting with Dubbii I get to bed before midnight every night and follow the same steps. And I even get to sleep easier! 
I started using the videos and then started the group live sessions which have been a game changer. Not only can I now get up at a regular time, I even like my mornings! The live session hosts are so supportive and upbeat, and Rox and Rich’s videos are really fun and accessible. Definitely worth it.
author: BryaLyon

title: Room CLEANED and felt so seen
body: Thank you so so much Rich and Rox. Have loved your podcasts and they helped me start my late diagnosis 29yo woman who always thought she was lazy and messy. I was not even prompted by Dubbi to write a review like those annoying pop ups on other apps, but I’m lying here in a totally clean room that would not have been possible without Dubbi. I swear I restarted the clutter section of Big Mess Room Clean, about 5-6 times, but it was the only way I got through it. 50AUD is not asking too much for a years worth of this, thanks for making it so accessible.

title: Thank you

author: rosiedawn

title: Thank You!
body: This is such a fantastic idea! I’m a mum of 3 and I have what I like to call a spicy brain. I have ADHD and I struggle to get simple tasks done throughout the day. Sometimes music helps or a tv show in the background but there’s nothing more motivating than doing a task with others. It keeps me on track and stops me from switching off which is ideal for the days when everything is overwhelming. Huge thanks for creating this!

That’s really surprising for me and I will be telling all my ADHD friends on my autistic friends who struggle like me to do daily task.

author: Blue sky night

title: I’m a 13-year-old girl who can’t tell anyone that she thinks she has ADHD
body: Hi, I’m 13 and I think I have ADHD but I also don’t really know because I’ve done a lot of research now. I think I’m just overthinking it and I’m making myself think I have it. Like things I’ve seen on your YouTube or anywhere else, I’m just making it up in my head like oh that’s totally been happening when it actually hasn’t but it might have been. I don’t know anyway I really hope you guys replied to this. I love your content and onto the app. It’s great but because I can’t tell my mum that I think I have ADHD. I can’t buy the full version so if I want to do a different task, I have to delete the app and then re-download it. Which is annoying but it gets the job done and it’s been super duper helpful. anyway please respond. Thanks so much for making such a useful app.

author: EKP100

title: Life-changing app
body:
I know dubbii is for adults, but I got it for my five year old, who’s just been diagnosed with ADHD and has a long history of challenging behaviours. Dubbii has turned our morning and night routines from a series of exhausting battles into something that my son gleefully hurls himself into with gusto and enthusiasm. He loves Rich and Rox, and their non-judgemental tone is beautiful. We have a tricky household with me and my oldest son being autistic, and my five yr old being ADHD with suspected autism, and dubbi’s helped all of us become more regulated because there are less battles. 

Also, I’m so sorry, my son also has a PDA profile so if the app receives “suggestions” that say “this is a silly app!” over and over  again, I caught him sending those over voice to text yesterday. He doesn’t mean it.

author: misstoni81

title: My kitchen looks AMAZING 👏🏻👏🏻
body:
Where has this been my whole life?!
On the one hand I’m embarrassed that I really need something like this and on the other hand I’m delighted that it exists!
It’s also nice to know there are other people just like me in the world who also need it.
I’ve always loved being on the phone while cleaning as the concentration required is so beyond me but it’s not always possible to rope friends and family into a call just so I can get housework done. This was even more effective than my phone call strategy and I cleaned things I would normally leave out. My kitchen/ dining table feels like a little slice of heaven!!!
author: Rianni468

title: Dubbii is a game changer!
body:
It is absolutely clear that the creators care for their users. I have followed them for a long time! Creating relatable content for ADHDers. Now solutions to some of the most simple yet painful tasks! 

ADHD can be debilitating, especially when you need a body double. I see huge potential for this app and I love how they “remind you” and give you a nudge before you get impulsive and purchase the subscription! The subscription being reasonably priced as well!! 

This app stands out from other quick cash apps that don’t actually do anything to help people with ADHD. Other apps have little to no extra help. “Write a list” blah blah. 
Whereas we are given videos! Two types of instructions!! EXTRA help! Lots of options! 

I cannot express how much these creators care about their community and it is abundantly clear they do! 💕

That is the only way I can describe how it mentally feels to use Dubbii!!! This app is a GAME CHANGER!!! 

I had NO IDEA how complicated and inefficiently made I cleaning…. 🫣
author: Annie Squirrel

title: Changed my life
body:
This app is amazing and I’m so grateful for it. In one day I have managed to clean my bedroom and kitchen top to bottom which is unheard off.

I mean, usually it would take me three days to clean one room. I would get debilitating paralysis as I was unsure where to start, then once finally being able to get on with it, I would get bogged down in task multiplication, waste time, feel hopeless and watch the junk and clutter pile up around me again. 

Thank you thank you thank you. I feel human again.
author: HarleyJ8856

title: Undiagnosed
body:
At the age of 42, I begun to realise that there’s a 99% chance that I have ADHD and am on the wait list to see a psych - who knows how long that will be. 

Whilst I don’t have a diagnosis, I can honestly relate to practically every that Rox shares, from not replying (or even opening) text messages, forgetting to shower, picking my clothes out of the floordrobe or washing the same load 5 times because I forget to hang it out. 

In my own research on ADHD, before I stumbled upon ADHD Love I had read about body doubling and how it can be useful to get things done. Reflecting back on my own behaviours, I realise that I definitely find it easier to do these mundane tasks when I have someone else around… so when you live alone, where does that get you? 

At first I was skeptical that the app would motivate me, but it is amazing how much it has helped and changed my routine. This morning I found myself tidying up my lounge before the app even reminded me. 

The only thing I would love to change is reminder function. It would be so much easier if could set the next time you did something by selecting a date or time, rather than adjusting it in hourly increments.

author: Anonymous4444!$

title: This what everyone needs but don’t know they need.
body:
When I found myself cleaning my windows this morning I knew it was time to write a review. As for without this App that would never have happened. 

However, first the back story picture this there I am doom scrolling and I discover I Rich and Roxy and ADHD love. 

They lead me to this App I was obviously highly skeptical. How would this help but there is an option to try out task and my lounge looked like a bomb had exploded my cleaning was more a case of moving things round into different piles and trying to clean around them. 

So I gave it a go and I was impressed but I didn’t buy the App straight away aren’t you impressed. I waited till my lounge looked like a tornado had hit. 

I wanted to know how much all this would cost as this wasn’t so clear, at least it wasn’t for me.  I had only recently gotten stung for forgetting to cancel a subscription which I had paid heavily for. 

How can you complain when you signed up but not cancelled in their “free window”? I have cancelled now. I digress ever so slightly so I emailed like a crazy person and got the answer. 

I honestly find it really helpful and would encourage anyone and everyone to give this a go.
